sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 4$ in deductive reasoning, evaluate $f(5)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 10x + 24 = 0$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 4$ and $x = 6$. Factoring $(x - 4)(x - 6) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 4$ and $x = 6$.

questions.q: In $\Delta  ABC$ studying properties of equality and congruence, $m\angle A = 39^\circ$ and $m\angle B = 45^\circ$. What is $m\angle C$? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $96^\circ$. Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (39^\circ + 45^\circ) = 96^\circ$.
questions.explanation: Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (39^\circ + 45^\circ) = 96^\circ$.

questions.q: A geometric figure scaled by factor $k = 2$ has an original side length of $8\mathrm{\ cm}$. What is the corresponding image length? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $16\mathrm{\ cm}$. Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $8 \times 2 = 16\mathrm{\ cm}$.
questions.explanation: Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $8 \times 2 = 16\mathrm{\ cm}$.
